recent_en: Recent filings are mainly repeated changes in substantial shareholder interest by Yeoman Capital Management, Yeoman 3-Rights Value Asia Fund, Lim Mee Hwa and Yeo Seng Chong between September and November 2026. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 31/07/2026 on 2026-09-28, alongside an 'OTHERS' announcement the same day.
notable_en: Substantial shareholders Yeoman Capital Management, Yeoman 3-Rights Value Asia Fund, Lim Mee Hwa and Yeo Seng Chong filed multiple changes in interest between September and November 2026.
The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 31/07/2026 on 2026-09-28.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders filed multiple changes in interest between September and November 2026; the direction of the changes requires reading the announcement details.
